name: vampire_gourmand_sacrifice_draws_and_cant_be_blocked
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card and this creature can't be blocked this turn.' The Gourmand attacks and seat 0 sacrifices its Bear (its other creature): seat 0 draws a card, and seat 1's Bear has no legal block and is never asked; seat 1 takes 2.
